model_output.rationale: 271 confirms EB*6 (inactive) with eligibility end DTP*357 = 2025-05-31, before DOS 2025-06-17. All lines carry PR-27 under filing indicator CI (commercial). No EB*R, no successor payer, no Medicare secondary, no QMB or other override. PR on a commercial plan with confirmed terminated coverage = patient liability.

root_cause.explanation: Patient's Keystone Commercial EPO coverage ended 2025-05-31 per 271 (EB*6, DTP*357). DOS 2025-06-17 is 17 days after termination. Payer correctly denied PR-27 on all lines.

next_action.detail: Issue patient statement for $204.23. Coverage was inactive on DOS; PR group assigns liability to the patient. No other payer identified in the 271. Confirm no successor coverage before billing.

evidence.fact: EB*6 (inactive), eligibility end DTP*357 = 2025-05-31, before DOS 2025-06-17
All four lines adjusted PR-27 (patient responsibility, coverage terminated), total $204.23
Filing indicator CI (commercial insurance); no secondary payer indicated
No EB*R (other payer) present; only EB*6 inactive coverage returned

citations.rule: CI, EB*6 + DTP*357 before DOS, no successor: PR-27 → bill_patient
